sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hol*? asks where. In this unit it is used in short questions about where someone lives.

Hol? is one of the shortest, highest-mileage words you’ll learn — three letters that unlock every ‘where’ question about location. Hol laksz? asks where you live, and later it’ll ask where anything else is too. Keep it mentally separate from Hová? (‘where TO’), which shows up once movement enters the picture.
